drivers.price.rationale: Delayed quote retained from prior captured edition.

drivers.shares.rationale: Cross-check: annual PDF p48 no dilutive potential shares; H1 EPS basic equals diluted. No verified September capital register.

drivers.cash.rationale: No assumed September roll-forward or future operating receipts.

drivers.investments.rationale: 48.417 financial assets plus 43.864 associates. Greentech subsequently delisted, p28; not current realizable values.

drivers.ownership.rationale: 50% applied only to whole-project economics; operating cash inputs are already attributable.

drivers.other_commitments.rationale: 16.79 capital plus 1.94 tenement commitments. Reserved conservatively, separately from additional buffer; no future operating cash credited.

drivers.tax_rate.rationale: 30% statutory reference, applied to adjusted operating cash less accounting D&A; ignores loss shields/tax-depreciation differences.

drivers.investment_haircut.rationale: 25% illustrative liquidity/valuation haircut, not an appraisal; includes Greentech delisting and associate uncertainty.

drivers.closure.rationale: A$50m paid at chosen end of life, not reported closure cash. Reported provision A$34.48m is discounted; do not equate the two.

drivers.life.rationale: Eight-year stress; March-2025 reserve life was nine years, not nine years remaining today. Requires updated depleted mine schedule.

drivers.rate.rationale: 10% scenario hurdle, not an estimated WACC.

drivers.annual_cash.basis: Attributable after-tax operating cash before financing
drivers.annual_cash.rationale: 100m stress exceeds FY2025 adjusted 74.075m; stronger H1 motivates testing, not automatic annualization. Corporate costs and recurring capital included.

drivers.project_capital.basis: Whole-project AUDm paid at time zero
drivers.project_capital.rationale: 500m stress only; no current sanctioned Rentails cost. Do not use the 2017 study as current guidance.

drivers.project_life.rationale: 15-year stress only; no reserve-backed project schedule.

drivers.first_cash_year.basis: Years after valuation to first end-year receipt
drivers.first_cash_year.rationale: First receipt in year three, not a company commissioning promise; FEED late 2026 and FID 2027 are earlier milestones.

drivers.project_closure.rationale: 50m additional closure stress, separate from operating asset closure; validate incremental overlap when integrated schedule exists.

drivers.cash_buffer.rationale: 100m illustrative reserve, above identified commitments and debt; no user policy implied.

limitations: Conditional arithmetic, not a supported fair value or current project estimate.
June cash, debt, shares and investment carrying amounts are not September balances.
Flat annual cash excludes changes in working capital, remaining-2026 stub, ramp and depletion schedules.
Investment haircut, mine life, closure, discount rate, cash buffer and project economics are analyst stress assumptions.
Historical tax uses accounting depreciation; no full tax-loss, tax-depreciation or sustaining-capital normalization.
No new X searches in this valuation follow-up; retain earlier evidence dates.
